notes:
Summary: Argosy is a payments-first customer support platform focused on automating refunds and escalations for large merchants. Primary interest: reliable tool-calling to create/update tickets, call Stripe refunds, and escalate to ops via internal APIs while preserving full audit trail.

What they told us / requirements (shorthand):
- Use-cases: agent-assist (refund suggestion + one-click action), post-call ticket summarize+auto-route, programmatic refunds, automated escalations for chargebacks.
- Latency/throughput: p95 generation < 500ms for agent UI; peak bursts up to 2k req/min for scripted refunds during promo spikes; steady-state ~200-400 rps. Cost sensitive for high-volume merchants.
- Model preferences: want deterministic small-chat models for tool-calling logic + larger model for summarization and NER extraction. Open to Redwood-verified open models but need quantization recommendations.
- Reliability: must support graceful degradation: if model endpoint overloaded, fall back to cached suggested actions or queue to human-in-the-loop. No silent failures on refund tool-calls.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs for every tool-call (who/what/when), key management via HSM/KMS, EU data residency for EU merchant data, retention controls (30-90-365 day plans).
- Integration surface: Zendesk (create/update tickets), internal RefundOps API (POST /refunds with idempotency-key), Stripe Refund API (test stripe account), ServiceNow for enterprise customers. Need sample playbook for error handling and automatic rollback semantics if refund fails after ticket updated.

Quotes / call notes: "We cannot risk double-refunds — idempotency and strong audit trails are non-negotiable." — Head of Ops
"If Redwood can show a 2k/min burst without >1% error rate we can move to dedicated capacity." — CTO

POC specifics/asks:
- Dedicated staging endpoint for load-test + example tool-calling connector to our RefundOps API (we'll provide network access during POC).
- SSO demo with SAML; sample audit-log export for 90-day retention.
- E2E scenario: call summarization -> generate refund recommendation -> agent approves -> tool-call executes refund -> ticket auto-updates with refund transaction id and audit metadata.

Open items: pricing for reserved capacity, SLA for tool-call retries, HSM timelines, legal signoff on EU residency.

Next meeting: 2026-03-22 load-test kickoff (internal prep: supply traffic script + sample sandbox credentials).
